items.computation: Letter dated Fri 16.04.2027. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (16.04.) is not counted; counting starts 17.04.2027. The letter defines Werktage itself as Monday–Saturday, excluding statutory public holidays (none fall in this window in NW). Counting 6 such Werktage: 17.04. (Sat, day 1), 19.04. (Mon, day 2), 20.04. (Tue, day 3), 21.04. (Wed, day 4), 22.04. (Thu, day 5), 23.04. (Fri, day 6). 23.04.2027 is itself a Friday business day, so no further weekend/holiday shift is needed.
